company_name: Shanghai HongTeng Intl Trading Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Shanghai HongTeng specializes in semiconductor packaging adhesive products, which are critical for various semiconductor applications.
summary: Shanghai HongTeng Intl Trading Co., Ltd. is a professional company focused on selling semiconductor packaging adhesive products used in IC packaging, LEDs, and optical fibers. They are the sole agent for Die attach series and Diemat conductive adhesives from NAMICS Corp, providing innovative solutions for the electronic packaging industry.
capabilities: Die attach adhesives for semiconductor applications
Conductive and insulating materials for electronics
Thermal-cured adhesives for die bonding and LED bonding
technical_expertise: Innovative sealing materials for electronic applications
